firm_data.firm_description: Colligan Law LLP is a firm that provides legal services for businesses and business owners. Our clients include established businesses, startup companies, entrepreneurs, venture capitalists, angel investors and cutting-edge technology companies.
notable_facts: Focused on growth company, startups and entrepreneurial representation.

email.subject: AI for Colligan Law LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi David,

Your focus on high-growth ventures and startup clients puts you at the center of companies that move fast and demand precision legal work. That's exactly the pressure our AI platform was built for.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding regionally to meet firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by Buffalo on a day that works for you to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
